snippet.title: Truck Driver: The American Dream | Steam Release Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

Live the ultimate trucker life in Truck Driver: The American Dream, now coming to Steam with brand-new features! Follow Nathan as he honors his late father's legacy, hauling cargo across stunning open-world highways in Unreal Engine 5-powered realism.
Experience revamped gameplay with new Steam exclusive features: enhanced truck customization, free roam mode with dynamic weather/events, improved physics for next-gen precision handling.
Deliver diverse freight, build family ties and town relationships, upgrade your rig from classic to beast-mode semis. Realistic driving meets heartfelt story. Perfect for American Truck fans craving narrative depth.

🚚 STEAM LAUNCH: 2026
Published by Soedesco. Available on Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S.
Wishlist Links:
💻 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925460/Truck_Driver_The_American_Dream
Add to your wishlist now and hit the road!

Video editors: 
@juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
